summary: All 31,299 author-reported cell barcodes matched GEO, including their sex and replicate assignments. The nine supplementary files report scRNA-seq expression by neuronal cluster and sex-related MERFISH images, but none provides a gene-level male-versus-female effect across all six registered preoptic pools. The proposal passed validation, and no ledger was edited. [Author supplements](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/studies/S-EPMC6482113)
openIssues: GEO and ENA describe three mice per sequencing pool. The supplementary methods report four to five. Only the authors can confirm how many mice contributed to each library.
